resolution.summary: Reviewed remaining acceptance criteria for L02, L03, L04, L06 and L08. Recommend the bounded follow-up/intent protocol in L04 first because document linking and finish receipts exist; repository-contained skills and portable fallback next; deterministic large-ledger profiling next. Distinguish bounded improvements from universal agent compliance, and candidate-model pilots from completing the entire research task. No development was requested or performed.
